changeSet.author: snowman
changeSet.comment: Remove dummy users seeded with default credentials
changeSet.sql: delete from user where (id = 1 and username = 'username' and email = 'username@email.com') or (id = 2 and username = 'admin' and email = 'admin@email.com') or (id = 3 and username = 'test' and email = 'test@email.com') or (id = 4 and username = 'dev' and email = 'dev@email.com');
